title: Add Multi-Monitor Panel Settings
instructions: Add settings to PanelConfigDialog for selecting which monitor/screen the panel displays on. Options should include: Primary monitor, Specific monitor (by index), All monitors. Also add option to follow active monitor when switching with wmctrl. Update Panel to respect these settings and position itself accordingly.

1785089416.9740772.instruction: Add "monitor" field to panel configuration with options: "primary", "specific" (with index), "all", "follow_active". Update default config in Panel and PanelConfigDialog.

1785089419.1755662.instruction: Add a Monitor section to PanelConfigDialog with: QComboBox for mode (Primary, Specific Monitor, All Monitors, Follow Active), QSpinBox for specific monitor index (enabled only when mode is "specific"). Connect to preview and save.

1785089421.9030576.instruction: Modify Panel to: detect available monitors using QDesktopWidget or QScreen, add method to position panel on specific monitor, handle "follow_active" mode by monitoring active window/monitor changes, update panel position when configuration changes.
